title: Copying One Row Field
statement: Let $l$ be a natural number, $x$ and $w(i)$ finite Boolean words, $p$ an input-head position for $x$, $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(l)$, and $record$ a finite Boolean word. There is a natural number $t$ with $0<t\le 3|w(i)|+4$ such that, after $t$ steps of the row machine from field $i$ in copier start control, it is at field $i+1$ in copier start control; the input position and all counter words and their heads are unchanged, the record is extended by the self-delimiting encoding of $w(i)$, and the physical output is empty.
hypotheses_covered: family $w$ of Boolean words indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(l)$
replaced: For every input word, input position, selected counter $i$, counter words $w$, and record, there is a strictly positive time $t \le 3|w(i)| + 4$ after which the row controller has appended the self-delimiting encoding of $w(i)$ to the record and advanced its field index from $i$ to $i+1$, with the entire counter bank, the input head, and the empty physical output restored.
